The background `pnpm test` run (the `C.UTF-8` part) has now finished, but its notification doesn't tell us anything new. The "exit code 0" is from the final `echo` in my wrapper, not from `pnpm test`. I deleted that log while the run was still writing to it, so its real exit code and the counts for its later Vitest invocations are lost.

The handback stands as written: §3 row 2b says the exit code was not captured, and §7 lists a clean rerun of `pnpm test` in both locales as remaining work.
